# Design point P014

## Description

Any healthy server can materialize the requested repository state on demand, without relying on authoritative per-repository placement records. Replica equivalence can then be checked using incrementally maintained XOR checksums, updating the checksum by removing old pair hashes and adding new ones as references change.
